notes.title: Update 0.27.431

notes.title: Update 0.25.405
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, everyone![/h1]

We’re excited to share a long-awaited update about the project! 🎉

[h2]Current Status:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The project is alive and in active development.
[*] Unfortunately, updates are posted less frequently because I'm working on the project solo. Thank you for your patience and support! 💪
[/list]

[h2]Outdated Info:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Old trailers and screenshots no longer reflect the current state of the project, so please keep that in mind.[/b][/u]
[/list]

[h2]What’s Done:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The character system has been upgraded to version 5, making the skeleton, visuals, and animations more realistic and fully compatible with modern technologies and systems.
[*] A basic character editor has been added. You’re no longer stuck with presets; you can now customize your character’s appearance. While the options are limited for now, it’s close to being a fully-fledged editor.
[*] Movement mechanics have been completely revamped.
[*] The logic for the starting map and menu has been overhauled.
[*] Fixed issues with saving game settings.
[/list]

[h2]What’s in Progress:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A complete refactor of the weapon system, including a core replacement.
[*] Gradual deployment of a more complex backend architecture.
[/list]

[h2]What’s Coming Next:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvements to the inventory, hotbar, and UI.
[*] Replacement of the old melee combat system.
[*] Addition of a weapon crafting workbench.
[*] Preparation of the core game mode.
[*] Parallel development of related systems.
[/list]

Thank you for sticking with the project. Your support keeps me motivated to push forward! ❤️
PS: and that's not all that's been done here..

notes.title: Preparing for early testing...
"Danger is Near" - Prepare for a New Era of Virtual Adventures!
notes.content:
Hello, esteemed gamers and seekers of new gaming experiences!

Today, I want to share with you the details of our exciting indie project, "Danger is Near." For those who may not be aware, work on the project began earlier this year, and we are currently actively preparing for the first limited testing phase. While the timelines may shift slightly, we are committed to achieving high-quality results and are ready to overcome any challenges.

A bit about the project:
🎮 At the moment, "Danger is Near" is in the prototyping phase, but we are confident that the project will find its niche.
🎯 "Danger is Near" combines elements of survival, weapon and combat simulation, RPG, and MMO, promising you an unforgettable gaming experience.
🌎 We are diligently working on building the foundational architecture of the game world, adding new mechanics, and expanding player capabilities.
💰It's important to note that "Danger is Near" is being developed with limited resources, but our passion and ambitions are boundless!

What's important to know:
🗓️ While the timelines may shift, the first testing is planned for 2024. This is your chance to gain exclusive access to the game!
💬 We look forward to your valuable feedback and suggestions to make "Danger is Near" better.
📢 All project details, its status, and news will be available first on the official Discord server of the project.

"Danger is Near" will undoubtedly capture your heart and change your perception of shooters. Our team is dedicated to creating an immersive gaming world that will leave you amazed!

Get ready for new virtual adventures with "Danger is Near"! Stay tuned for updates and join us on Discord to stay informed about all the latest developments and opportunities. You can become a part of this amazing gaming story.

Stay tuned, "Danger is Near" is coming! 🚀🎮
